clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads in the Barrens, Kil'hala teaches Horde tailors to work cloth. He also weaves nether-lace robes for young Horde mages who bring him locks of hair from Ashenvale's laughing sisters.

Kil'hala trains tailors at the Crossroads, where Horde recruits and travelers can learn his craft. He teaches work with common spun bolts and garments suited to life on the dry plains. At Deino's request, he also makes nether-lace robes for young mages who bring him hair from the laughing sisters, the dryads of Ashenvale's forests.
